# Annex C - Variable reference {#sec-annex-c}

This annex lists the shared simulation state, the settings, and the EDEN
module fields. Mission scripts can read any `aee_*` variable. The tables
follow the variable names as written in the SQF source.

## Simulation state

### Positioning consistency

The consistency monitor (aee-mgrs-and-positioning task 14) publishes these
values. The per-frame handler id is state; the divergence flag and the
verdict list are the API a mission or a probe reads.

| Variable | Subsystem | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `aee_core_consistencyPFH` | core | Position-consistency monitor per-frame handler id |
| `aee_core_positionDivergence` | core | True when a position invariant diverges |
| `aee_core_positionVerdicts` | core | Per-invariant consistency verdicts |

### MGRS grid and the signal tracker

The world geographic anchor is read once from `CfgWorlds` and cached. The
MGRS letter tables load once at preInit. The signal tracker replaces the
exact friendly position with a modelled one, and it publishes the per-track
records that the draw function and the GPS readout consume.

| Variable | Subsystem | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `aee_core_geoAnchor` | core | World geographic anchor: [latitude, longitude, zone, mapSize, lonWest, latSouth, lonEast, latNorth, sourceToken] |
| `aee_core_mgrsTables` | core | MGRS letter tables loaded at preInit: bands, column sets, rows, even-zone offset, zone strings and digit characters |
| `aee_optics_trackerTracks` | optics | Per-track records: displayed position, ellipse, track age and fix quality |
| `aee_optics_trackerR95` | optics | The largest error radius in the group, metres |
| `aee_optics_trackerFix` | optics | The worst fix quality in the group (`none`, `degraded` or `ok`) |
| `aee_optics_trackerPrev` | optics | Per-unit previous fix state for the continuity kernel |
| `aee_optics_trackerTime` | optics | Mission time of the last tracker survey, seconds |
| `aee_optics_trackerLogAt` | optics | Mission time of the next suppression log line, seconds |

### Engine environment bridges

These variables back the local engine bridges (issue #141). Each bridge is
client-only and derives from deterministic state, so none is broadcast.

| Variable | Subsystem | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `aee_atmos_localWindActive` | atmos | True while the rotor-wash visual is applied |

### Thermal

The thermal solver publishes its cross-module state for the consistency
harness and the KAT integration. Each row states its grade.

| Variable | Subsystem | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `aee_thermal_humanCoreTempC` | thermal | Human core temperature from the two-node solver: 0.1 skin + 0.9 core (Gagge 1986). Published for a human selection only. Grade: derived |
| `aee_thermal_skyBandTempC` | thermal | Last computed band sky temperature in C, from the Tebo 1965 8-14 um envelope applied by `fnc_calculateSkyRadiance`. Grade: derived-from-measurement |
| `aee_thermal_groundNodeStack` | thermal | Four-layer ground node-stack state, a HashMap keyed by grid cell and material. The value is six elements: four layer temperatures at node depths 0.05 / 0.25 / 0.70 / 1.50 m (C), the deep-soil TBOT anchor (C), and the last-advance tick. A water cell stores the water temperature six times |
| `aee_thermal_display_agcHunt` | thermal_display | View-owned AGC-hunt telemetry written by `fnc_applyThermalVision`; no reader (debug readout) |
| `aee_thermal_display_nucDrift` | thermal_display | View-owned NUC-drift telemetry written by `fnc_applyThermalVision`; no reader (debug readout) |
| `aee_thermal_display_temporalNoise` | thermal_display | View-owned temporal-noise telemetry written by `fnc_applyThermalVision`; no reader (debug readout) |

Mobility Index value while the vehicle records and the VCI50 source are

variables `aee_mobility_currentVCI1`, `aee_mobility_currentVCI50`, and
`aee_mobility_currentMobilityIndex` are cleared with nil.

### Core diagnostics

The core module reports its own health and the cross-module consistency
verdict. The throttled consistency monitor publishes its verdict each
sample. The producer variables it reads are declared in
`data/consistency/invariants.json` and documented with their own modules.

| Variable | Subsystem | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `aee_core_moduleHealth` | core | Runtime module-health report: an array of `[component, preInit, postInit]` per module, read back by the debug index and the P100 probe. The report writes it once, 10 s after core postInit |
| `aee_core_consistencyState` | core | Consistency verdict `[overallPass, per-row verdicts, modulesInDisagreement]` from `fnc_evaluateConsistency`. Read back by the monitor to detect its first run |
| `aee_core_consistencyFailures` | core | One failure message per failing invariant, the same payload the monitor logs at WARN |
| `aee_core_consistencyLast` | core | Mission time of the last consistency sample, the throttle cursor |
| `aee_perfCounters` | core | Performance-counter samples from the `BEGIN`/`END_COUNTER` macros, read by `fnc_dumpPerformanceCounters` |
| `aee_pfhCounter` | core | Per-frame-handler timing samples from the debug macros, read by `fnc_dumpPerformanceCounters` |

### Night-sky debug hooks

Five `missionNamespace` hooks force the night sky for an in-game check. The
consolidated line is greppable by `sky state`.

| Hook | Type | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `aee_lighting_skyForce` | Boolean | Force the whole night sky on |
| `aee_lighting_auroraForce` | Number | -1 off, 0..1 forces that aurora intensity |
| `aee_lighting_milkyWayForce` | Boolean | Force the Milky Way on |
| `aee_lighting_starsForce` | Number | Forced limiting magnitude (6.5 reveals the faint bulk) |
| `aee_lighting_meteorForce` | String | One-shot shower code (spawns one meteor) |

Set a hook from the debug console with the `missionNamespace setVariable`
form:

```
missionNamespace setVariable ["aee_lighting_skyForce", true];
missionNamespace setVariable ["aee_lighting_auroraForce", 0.8];
missionNamespace setVariable ["aee_lighting_milkyWayForce", true];
missionNamespace setVariable ["aee_lighting_starsForce", 6.5];
missionNamespace setVariable ["aee_lighting_meteorForce", "GEM"];
```

Clear every hook and return to the physics:

```
missionNamespace setVariable ["aee_lighting_skyForce", false];
missionNamespace setVariable ["aee_lighting_auroraForce", -1];
missionNamespace setVariable ["aee_lighting_milkyWayForce", false];
missionNamespace setVariable ["aee_lighting_starsForce", 0];
```

Every `logDebug` switch registers under **AEE Debug > <component>**. The
coverage-gaps release added one to every addon that declares settings, so
all nineteen sit in one place, grouped by the owning component.

### Exposure pin test (thermal)

`aee_thermal_agcPinned` is a debug-console switch, not a registered
setting.  The AEE Thermal > Display > base channel setting selects how the
thermal display is drawn.  Vanilla TI (the default) draws it on the engine's
own thermal channel; DTV disables the vehicle's native TI and draws it on
the day channel, the route the A3TI and MKK thermal mods use.

The pin test settles whether the engine itself auto-exposes in vanilla TI
mode.  In the debug console type:

```
aee_thermal_agcPinned = true; setTIParameter ["OutputRangeStart", 0]; setTIParameter ["OutputRangeWidth", 1];
```

The switch suspends the AGC and the engine-window writer, so the engine
window stays pinned at the full 0..1 range.  Pan across a cold wall and a
hot engine.  If the image brightness holds, the engine does not auto-expose;
if it brightens and darkens as the hot source fills the view, the engine is
auto-exposing.  `aee_thermal_agcPinned = false` restores the automatic
window.

311 settings register in the CBA settings interface. Three categories carry
the diagnostics and the experimental work: **AEE Experimental > Fusion**
(the four thermal-fusion knobs), **AEE HUD > Displays** (the on-screen
displays, the MGRS grid settings, the NVG laser target marker and the laser
daylight fade), and **AEE Debug >
component** (every diagnostic switch, grouped by the owning component,
including the new AI and Wildlife subcategories). The
remaining categories are one per module: AEE (core), AEE Optics, AEE
Physiology, AEE Environmental, AEE Atmos, AEE Maritime, AEE Radio, AEE
Mobility, AEE FX, AEE Thermal, AEE Armour, AEE Ballistics, AEE Night
Vision, AEE Wildlife, AEE ACE3, AEE ACM, AEE KAT, AEE ACRE2, AEE TFAR, and
AEE Real Weather. The compat categories appear only when their host mod is
loaded.
All settings use `CBA_fnc_addSetting`; titles and descriptions come from
the per-addon stringtables. See the Configuration chapter for the full
table.

| `aee_ai_disturbance` | ai | The local disturbance field, an array of `[[cx,cy], magnitude, time]` |
| `aee_ai_lastReport` | ai | The last stimulus broadcast time, for the rate limit |
| `aee_ai_aiPFH` | ai | The substrate client tick handle |

## Wildlife ambience state

The client-local ambient-sound ecology publishes its live state for the
operator and the debug console.

| Variable | Subsystem | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `aee_ambience_soundInstances` | ambience | The live one-shot expiry times, bounded by the instance cap |
| `aee_ambience_ambientSource` | ambience | The current looping CfgSFX bed source |
| `aee_wildlife_manifest` | wildlife | The loaded vanilla sound manifest |
| `aee_ambience_ambientPFH` | ambience | The wildlife client tick handle |
| `aee_wildlife_firedManEH` | wildlife | The core player engine handler key for the gunfire report |

## Wildlife fauna state

The client-local fauna driver publishes its live list and its resource
providers. The per-animal needs and herd anchor live on the agent object.

| Variable | Subsystem | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `aee_wildlife_fauna` | wildlife | The live fauna list, one entry per spawned animal |
| `aee_wildlife_speciesTable` | wildlife | The loaded vanilla species table |
| `aee_wildlife_herds` | wildlife | The herd anchors, one entry per species cluster |
| `aee_wildlife_waterProvider` | wildlife | The water proximity provider stored for the action callback |
| `aee_wildlife_vegProvider` | wildlife | The vegetation score provider stored for the action callback |
| `aee_wildlife_hunger` | wildlife | Per-animal hunger, an object variable |
| `aee_wildlife_thirst` | wildlife | Per-animal thirst, an object variable |
| `aee_wildlife_herdAnchor` | wildlife | Per-animal herd leash centre, an object variable |

## Wildlife ecology state

The ecology layer publishes its corpus, its environment cache, its cognition
queue and its communication buses. The per-animal rules, perception and heard
call live on the agent object.

| Variable | Subsystem | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `aee_wildlife_assetMap` | wildlife | The loaded species-to-sound asset map |
| `aee_wildlife_ecologyCorpus` | wildlife | The loaded species ecology corpus |
| `aee_wildlife_environment` | wildlife | The per-cell environment sample cache, bounded and aged |
| `aee_wildlife_environmentPending` | wildlife | The unsampled grid cells, re-queued at the front |
| `aee_wildlife_environmentLastMs` | wildlife | The elapsed milliseconds of the last sampler call |
| `aee_wildlife_ecologyPending` | wildlife | The animals not yet solved this ecology cycle |
| `aee_wildlife_callBus` | wildlife | The heard-call bus, bounded and decayed |
| `aee_ambience_soundEvents` | ambience | The propagated sound-event bus |
| `aee_ambience_soundSchedule` | ambience | The species emission schedule for the current hour |
| `aee_wildlife_speciesEmit` | wildlife | The per-group emission gate state |
| `aee_wildlife_emitters` | wildlife | The live attached 3D sound emitters |
| `aee_ambience_ambientKey` | ambience | The ambient bed source key, for the recreate guard |
| `aee_wildlife_lastTickMs` | wildlife | The elapsed milliseconds of the last wildlife tick |
| `aee_wildlife_speciesRules` | wildlife | Per-animal species rules, an object variable |
| `aee_wildlife_habitatWeights` | wildlife | Per-animal habitat weights, an object variable |
| `aee_wildlife_soundGroup` | wildlife | Per-animal asset-map sound group, an object variable |
| `aee_wildlife_speciesGroup` | wildlife | Per-animal ecology species group, an object variable |
| `aee_wildlife_perception` | wildlife | Per-animal perception vector, an object variable |
| `aee_wildlife_ecologyState` | wildlife | Per-animal ecology state vector, an object variable |
| `aee_wildlife_heardCall` | wildlife | Per-animal last heard call, an object variable |

## Wildlife and AI debug hooks

These variables are read from missionNamespace and are not CBA settings. Set
them in the debug console to force an effect. They are documented in the
owning function headers.

| Hook | Type | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `aee_ai_forceDecide` | NUMBER | Override the decide output, `-1` is off, `0` to `4` is the action |
| `aee_ai_need` | NUMBER | Need pressure 0..1 on an anchor object |
| `aee_wildlife_forceBiome` | STRING | Override the listener biome |
| `aee_wildlife_forceNight` | BOOL | Override the day and night choice |
| `aee_wildlife_forceSpook` | ARRAY | Raise a spook wave at this position |
| `aee_wildlife_forceSilence` | NUMBER | Override the silence gain multiplier |
| `aee_wildlife_forceSpecies` | STRING | Force one animal class, bypassing the biome mix |
